How to read it: recurring cost is what one more unit costs at that order size. NRE is paid once (tooling, fixtures, certifications) and is shown spread over the order. Landed cost applies the destination's duty and tax multiplier to the recurring cost and adds freight; the 'incl. NRE' row also adds the NRE spread per unit.

## What drives the cost

**1 unit:** PCBA setup, stencil, loading, fixtures, handling (per order) $139 (38%, verified); Enclosure set: shell, back plate, cell door, button cap (4 printed parts), service-bureau SLA/MJF $30.0–140 (23%, estimate); Bare PCB prototype lot (5-10 panels) (per order) $30.0–90.0 (16%, estimate); Bare PCB, 4-layer 0.6 mm FR4, ENIG, black mask, 28.4 mm, panelized $8.00–25.0 (4%, estimate)

**1,000 units:** Final assembly (board into shell, gaskets, cell, 2 door screws), flashing, functional + RF + seal test, pack $1.20–3.50 (18%, estimate); Enclosure set molded in rapid aluminum T1 tools (PC/ABS shell, plate, door; TPU button), 3 colors $1.00–3.20 (16%, estimate); Molding run setup and color changes (graphite, chalk, smoke) (per order) $0.45–1.50 (8%, estimate); U1 CC2340R52E0RGER $0.85 (6%, verified)

**10,000 units:** Final assembly (board into shell, gaskets, cell, 2 door screws), flashing, functional + RF + seal test, pack $0.50–1.50 (14%, estimate); Enclosure set molded in hardened steel tools (4 parts), 3 colors $0.40–1.20 (11%, estimate); U1 CC2340R52E0RGER $0.76 (10%, verified); LS1 CPT-9019A-SMT-TR $0.50 (7%, verified)
